crossRefs.note: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”
But Naaman was angry, and went away, and said, “Behold, I thought, ‘He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call…
Aren’t Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Couldn’t I wash in them, and…
Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel and his Maker says: “You ask me about the things that are to come, concerning my sons…
Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.
But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”
